title: Cokret Peer Contact Delivery Request
description: Private service-to-service request used by an issuer-side Principal Server to deliver a signed contact fact (ck.contact.requested / ck.contact.accepted / ck.contact.rejected / ck.contact.tombstoned) to the target holder's Principal Server. The recipient projects the original signed envelope into the target holder's contact projection (pending_incoming / accepted / rejected / tombstoned); it MUST NOT re-sign the fact as its own. Contact facts are principal-scoped and cross-Realm, so this carrier is the federation delivery path for the contact fact log, separate from invite delivery.

contact_event.description: The issuer-signed contact fact EventEnvelope being delivered with its original signature, so the recipient can verify and project it without re-signing.

fact_kind.description: The contact fact kind carried by contact_event. MUST equal contact_event.kind.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the contact fact recipient (the request target, or the original requester for an accept/reject travelling back). The recipient Principal Server projects the fact into this holder's contact projection.

recipient_service_did.description: Principal Server service DID that hosts subject_id and accepts contact delivery for it.

recipient_service_type.description: v1 only allows Principal Server contact delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

status.description: Generic receive status. It MUST NOT reveal whether subject_id exists or whether the holder's receive policy suppressed the fact, beyond the optional disclosed_outcome graded disclosure that mirrors ck.peer.invites.submit.

disclosed_outcome.description: Optional graded-disclosure result, present only when the subject's receive policy disclosure level for this trust tier is 'outcome' and the subject did not block the issuer. Omitted (opaque) otherwise.
